name: parcel-delivery-manager.shipments.list
description: List parcels this person may see: their own parcels and parcels they are currently authorized to collect. Closed parcels (delivered, collected, returned) require include_closed. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.shipments.get
description: Read one parcel by its ID: physical status, current delivery plan, pending change, pickup readiness, deadlines and timeline. A delegate sees only the collection details of a parcel they are authorized for. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.options.get
description: For the parcel with this ID, list the delivery changes its policy currently allows (reschedule, address, hold, pickup redirect, back to home delivery, delegation) with eligible dates, addresses and points, and a reason when a change is not allowed. Recipient only. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.points.list
description: Search the pickup-point directory with hours, accessibility and current status. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.change.preview
description: Check a proposed delivery change for the parcel with this ID against its current plan and policy, without changing anything. kind selects the change: reschedule (delivery_date), address (address_id, optional delivery_date), hold (hold_until), redirect (point_id) or home_delivery (address_id, optional delivery_date). Returns the effect and a confirmation value that change.submit requires; the confirmation becomes stale when the parcel changes. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.change.submit
description: Submit a previewed delivery change for the parcel with this ID to the carrier, repeating the previewed fields and its confirmation. The request becomes pending; the delivery plan changes only when the carrier applies it.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.change.cancel
description: Withdraw the pending delivery change with this change ID. Fails with too_late once the carrier has decided it.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.changes.list
description: List delivery change requests and their decisions, optionally for one parcel. Recipient only. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.collectors.list
description: List the people this recipient has saved as trusted collectors. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.grants.list
description: List collection authorizations for the recipient's parcels, or the authorizations granted to this person when they are a delegate. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.grant.preview
description: Check whether a trusted collector can be authorized to collect the ready parcel with this ID until the given time, optionally replacing an existing authorization. Returns the limited access granted and a confirmation value. Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.grant.create
description: Authorize a trusted collector for the ready parcel with this ID at its current pickup point, or replace an existing authorization. Issues the collector a pass. Requires the confirmation returned by grant.preview.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.grant.revoke
description: Revoke the active collection authorization with this grant ID and invalidate its pass.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.pass.get
description: Show this person's current collection pass for the ready parcel with this ID (the recipient's own pass or a delegate's authorized pass). Read-only.

name: parcel-delivery-manager.notices.list
description: List in-app delivery notices visible to this person, optionally for one parcel. Read-only.
